faq: OnPini is the social game you play with the people you know. You each answer the same deck of questions blind, then see where you match and where you split. It’s not a dating app.
Friends, couples, crushes, family, classmates, group chats and fans. You need to be 16 or older.
Yes. It’s free to play, right in your browser.
Does the other person need to download anything?
No. Your link opens in their browser and they can answer right away. One free account opens the whole reveal.

The people you play with, once they’ve answered. Until then, neither of you sees a thing. Your decks also show on your page: from 18 they start on Public, so anyone on OnPini can play against your answers. You can switch any deck to Friends or Only me.
You’ll see how many answers match, like “Same on 6 of 10”. No winner, no verdict. Same answer, nice. Different answer, better.

story.metaTitle: Our story: why we built OnPini
story.metaDesc: Everyone’s connected. Nobody knows anybody. A few university grads from the Netherlands and Germany built the opposite: a social game with one rule.
story.title: Everyone’s connected.
story.neverLine: Every app gave us more people. None gave us more of a person.

turn.one: So a few university grads from the Netherlands and Germany went after the part every app skipped: what people actually think.
turn.two: The hard question was never the problem. Being the one who asks it was.
turn.title: So we handed it to a game.

rule.title: Show yours. See theirs.
rule.line: No lurking. No guessing. You answer, they answer, you both know.
rule.one: Most apps want more of your attention.
rule.two: We want you to go talk to each other.

keep.title: Ask once. Keep the answer.
keep.line: Every deck you play stays. Months later, it’s still there, right when you need it.
keep.title2: Then your profile plays for you.
keep.line2: The more you play, the more of you there is. People play your decks against your answers while you sleep.

mission.title: Nobody you love gets to stay a mystery.
mission.line: It starts with two people and one deck. Then your whole crew. Then the creators you follow. We’re building the place where what you think is who you are.

end.title: Don’t follow them.
end.door: Investor, brand or press? The door’s open.

items.pain: Every Sunday call: the weather, then your cousin.
He says ‘fine’ and passes the phone to your mom.
You finish each other’s sentences. Not each other’s answers.
Three weeks of ‘haha’. Nobody knows what this is.
items.win: Flirt with a deck. Blame the game.

items.pain: Small talk runs out before the drinks arrive.
items.win: Find out before the bill comes.

items.pain: Different time zones. The same ‘how was your day’.
items.win: Send a deck tonight. Wake up to the answers.
Now find out what they really thought.

items.pain: Memes all day. Nobody’s said anything real in months.
A room of strangers and one question: so, what are you studying?
There’s a note on the fridge. Nobody’s signing it.
items.win: Settle it before the next note.

items.pain: You lost. You’re still talking about it.
items.win: Both answers sealed. No backing down.
